_comment: Apharmd B skeleton inferred from the walk4 capture. The capture contains the full 17-part model (OBAs span both 0x00a7 and 0x00a8, so the OBA prefix is not a fighter id). The inference recovers a single rooted tree: torso 00a7f213 is the root, with the a80xxx leg chains and the a7fxxx arm chains hanging off it. Superseded the earlier 8-part hands-only override.
